title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft CS → ReturnOfTitleIV

source_tables.table: PeopleSoft Return of Title IV records
source_tables.description: Delivered R2T4 calculation: withdrawal date, percent earned, amounts earned and unearned, school and student returns, post-withdrawal disbursement. FLAG: confirm record names under Financial Aid > Return of Title IV for your release.
Withdrawal code, reason, and date for the term.
Last date of attendance for unofficial withdrawals. FLAG: confirm the attendance field your school uses.
Title IV disbursed and could-have-been-disbursed amounts.
Payment period start and end dates, for percent enrolled.

notes: R2T4 has hard federal deadlines: return funds within 45 days of the date the school determined the student withdrew, and offer a post-withdrawal disbursement of grant funds within 30 days (34 CFR 668.22). Convert every open R2T4 case, and keep closed ones for at least the record retention period.
privacy: RESTRICTED. This is a FERPA education record and GLBA-covered customer financial information. Land in bronze under the restricted KMS key, tokenize SAI, COD loan IDs, and PJ or appeal text at silver, and grant only to financial aid roles (govern/access-control-matrix.json, ACM-SPECIAL-002).

PeopleSoft AID_YEAR is the ending year: 2026 means 2025-2026. Emit '2025-2026'.
ISO date. For unofficial withdrawals use the last date of academically related activity, or the midpoint if unknown.
Official withdrawal codes -> official; all-F or no-attendance detection -> unofficial.
Calendar days completed / days in period, excluding scheduled breaks of 5 or more days.
Decimal. Returned in federal order: Unsub, Sub, Grad PLUS, Parent PLUS, Pell, FSEOG, TEACH.
Decimal. Grant overpayments under 50 dollars aren't collected.
Boolean. Loan PWDs need student confirmation; grant PWDs don't.
Tuition, fees, and on-campus housing and food for the period.
